report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services
observations_summary: The audit found a 34% overall shortage in manpower and inadequate public health infrastructure. Financial utilization was 82% of the allocated budget, but capital expenditure was very low at 7.64%. Delays and irregularities in procurement led to expiry of drugs worth ₹33.63 crore and avoidable expenditures. The state also lagged behind national averages in key health indicators and lacked a comprehensive State Health Policy.
